verdict.rationale: Mintlify's own docs say it generates interactive API reference pages from OpenAPI files, with automatic endpoint pages, request builders and navigation. Its API-reference use-case page states the docs are 'updated every time it changes', which covers the sync half of the story. missing for 10: documentation of how the sync works (e.g. a hosted spec URL or repository-push trigger) beyond the marketing claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration that pages stay in sync.

support.subject: As a developer, my API reference pages are generated from an OpenAPI spec and stay in sync when the spec changes

citations.quote: Generate interactive API documentation from OpenAPI specification files with automatic endpoint pages, request builders, and navigation.
Generated from the spec you already maintain, and updated every time it changes.
